fields.summary_ko.0: Space Exploration Technologies (SPCX) Wall Street consensus target is approximately $267, suggesting 93% upside potential, but the current $1.9 trillion valuation embeds years of execution risk including Starship commercialization.
fields.summary_ko.1: SpaceX trades at over 50x sales while maintaining negative net income and cash flows, making sentiment changes capable of significant stock impact, and appearing difficult to view as a near-term investment opportunity.
